reviews.author: Morgan Singer
reviews.text: The princess is top-notch all the way from the service to the rooms to the amenities to the pool. Absolutely fantastic!

reviews.author: Lanre Lawal
reviews.text: Still waiting for my refund reversal after a week of check in and 5days check out.

reviews.author: Sandy Smith
reviews.text:
The Scottsdale Princess is our go to resort to kick off Summer.  The resort is immaculate including grounds, pool, housekeeping.   With so many hotels cutting back on cleanliness and service, the Scottsdale Princess stands out in the area.  Enjoy laying by one of the pools and service is excellent.
Ate at Toro, was impressed with menu options for the whole family and top notch service.

reviews.author: Zach Sessums
reviews.text: Do not stay here. Overpriced and overrated. Terrible management. I spent over $1000 to stay here 1 night. Valet driver backed my truck into a tree and refuses to admit fault. They will not show me the camera footage unless I get a subpoena. We will never stay here again. They could have done the right thing and admitted fault and paid the ~$100 for paintless dent removal but refused to do so… Do not stay here.

reviews.author: Tiam Behdarvandan
reviews.text:
Everything has been terrible here!

MATTRESSES ARE BOWL SHAPED EXTREMELY UNCOMFORTABLE!

STAFF DO NOT COME TO CLEAN ON TIME. THEY ARE IGNORING OUR ROOM!

THEY CHARGE 20$ TO BRING ANYTHING TO YOUR ROOM EVEN THOUGH MY ROOM IS 3 STEPS FROM THE LOBBY!

TERRIBLE!!! HAVEN’T SLEPT IN 5 DAYS HERE BECAUSE OF THE MATTRESS

reviews.author: Aneesha Avalos
reviews.text: Enjoyed the entire weekend! From the concierge check in experience, bed turn down service, dinner and all the amenities thay the property provided.Could have stayed at the spa all day!!! Will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Mahi Keerthi
reviews.text: I had a great time with my family, and the environment is very luxury and welcoming, better suitable for families with younger kids

reviews.author: Deborah Wittmeyer
reviews.text: Roaches in our room🥺.   Unacceptable

reviews.author: kevin Hochstetler
reviews.text:
Just recently stayed for four nights and fell in love with the resort and their folks that work there. First off, the customer service was AMAZING. It was so refreshing to have been helped by people who enjoy working there. Whether it is Derek at the valet, whom got us on a golf cart and showed us around the resort to Austin the nice gentleman at the check in desk to Julie at one of their gift shops to the amazing staff at the Bourbon Steak house. (Food and drinks were top notch) Kenny the bartender was very good at his craft and made amazing cocktails. Hannah, who turned me on to a new drink was easy to talk to. Our waiter Jeffrey was a great guy and Lila the spicy "Water girl" was a hoot. Kevin the assistant GM was a great guy as well. We definitely enjoyed dining and drinking there. Then there was Toro one of the other Amazing restaurants Fairmont had to offer was awesome. Don, our waiter was AWESOME!! Great guy fun banter back and forth made our dining experience fun and delightful. It helped that their food was amazing as well. To the resort, everything we experienced was clean, smelled good and fresh. The bed was comfortable and the rooms were good size. The outdoor seating was comfortable and not beat up like you see in other resorts. The pools were beautiful and plentiful with so many on the property.  I will end this by saying we will most definitely be visiting again. We hope anyone that reads this has the experience my wife and I had.
Thank you Fairmont for a Wonderful time!!

reviews.author: Nettie Mutisya
reviews.text: Such an amazing getaway for some needed family time!

reviews.author: Kimberly Q
reviews.text: It’s completely disgusting that a five star hotel makes their employees pay $28 per day for parking. I would never give this establishment a penny of my money no matter how much I have.

reviews.author: E
reviews.text: Everybody was so kind. Property is stunning. Was upgraded at check-in and a beautiful experience followed. We will treasure our time spent at this resort, looking forward to returning soon. A special shout out to Alvin in guest services for making our Swig run possible!!!

reviews.author: Eric Gardiner
reviews.text: THE BEST.

reviews.author: Mera Blendi
reviews.text: Definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Mera Walnar
reviews.text: Best in town.

reviews.author: zxc vgsdf
reviews.text: Excellent service.

reviews.author: Michael Colosimo
reviews.text: The front desk completely understood the special request assignment. 10/10

reviews.author: Taekutzzz
reviews.text:
Absolutely incredible weekend at the Princess. From the moment we arrived, the atmosphere was top-tier. The grounds were beautiful, the staff was friendly, and everything felt clean, organized, and well-maintained.

The pool experience was exactly what we needed a perfect mix of relaxation, great music, good food, and amazing vibes. Whether you're looking for a family getaway, a couples retreat, or just a day to unwind, this place delivers.

The highlight of the night was definitely the fireworks show. Watching the sky light up while surrounded by great company made for an unforgettable experience. The ambiance throughout the entire resort was second to none, especially as the sun went down and everything transitioned into the evening atmosphere.

This was one of those experiences where you leave already planning your next visit. Arizona staycations don't get much better than this.

Highly recommend. 10/10 experience.

reviews.author: Carlos Co
reviews.text: Lodge coffee is like drinking water. Waste of money paid 80 bucks for 3 coffee and 3 french fries with bread.

reviews.author: Cameron
reviews.text:
Summary: I would not recommend the Fairmount Scottsdale if you are seeking an enjoyable, luxurious hotel stay. In the same manner, I would not recommend booking anytime around Memorial Day. The management and staff were completely unprepared for the influx of guests (to their own admission). This led to a chaotic and dysfunctional environment that lacked any type of care or attention to detail.

I stayed Memorial Day Weekend. It was absolute madness on Sunday at check-in. The line to the front desk was long, often extending past the concierge’s desk located on the opposite side of the room. Of course, this led to long wait times and guests skipping the line. I had to personally defend myself against a man who attempted to skip me in line and talk over me at the front desk counter. I appreciate the employee for coming to my defense, but this situation should have never happened in the first place. After waiting about 2 hours (1 hour past the 4pm check-in time), we were finally able to get room keys at 5:15pm.

The room was not a 5-star hotel quality. Room number was 1214. Lighting fixtures were not properly secured in the bathroom. The shower door would not close all the way. The door for the toilet was in desperate need of WD-40. Additionally, I found multiple outlets in the room did not work.

More on the property…the pools were extremely crowded during the day. At night, we went to the hot tub only to discover the jets only worked in one hot tub and not the other. We visited the Ironwood Kitchen for breakfast. After waiting 25 minutes for a table, I inquired about why we had not been seated and was told the text to let us know our table was ready never delivered. Once we are seated, we realize the place is not even half full. There should not have been any reason for a 25 minute wait.

All in all, I would not recommend especially for a couple looking for an enjoyable, 5-star experience. The location is good, but the Fairmount is definitely not the hotel to spend your birthday, anniversary, or really any meaningful celebration.

reviews.author: Liliana Mendoza
reviews.text:
Our family has visited the Fairmont for Memorial Day weekend for the past four years, traveling from Los Angeles. Unfortunately, our stay this year was disappointing.

Our children were looking forward to the annual summer kickoff event, but we discovered upon arrival that it had been moved to the following weekend to accommodate a private group. There was no mention of this change on your website. Had this been posted, we would have stayed in the Palm Springs area and avoided the five-hour drive.

In addition to the scheduling issue, we noticed that the service was slower than usual and the pools were not well-maintained. This experience was a significant departure from the high standards we have come to expect from the Fairmont.

reviews.author: CJ Julian
reviews.text:
We have been coming here for over a decade multiple times a year like clockwork when schools out we unwind at the princess or Christmas we are at the princess and multiple other times a year we like to relax and unwind at the quiet and always classy Princess
We have always had a quiet fun experience with our family but something has changed this year and not for the better
Same time as always right after school is out we unwind at the Princess but this year it was so packed and dirty and for some reason for the first time they had zero events planned for the kids nothing at all, so I’m not sure why it was still so busy but it was beyond packed and an absolute Mad House and keep in mind this is on a Sunday not Friday or Saturday this is a Sunday and we always do that on purpose due to the holiday so it’s nothing out of the ordinary for us to be here at this time or date for the last 10 plus years
The Gold lounge had standing room only and people were actually packed in like sardines People and kids were actually sitting on the floor because there was no where else to sit
With tons of kids everywhere and shirtless dads from the pool it was crazy and  it was a mad house even the staff knew something was off and we’re clearly not happy about it The good lounge lost it’s exclusivity for sure now it’s just budget buffet bringing in the hordes for free stuff
Even though we didn’t mention it to the staff they were apologizing for it which tells u a lot honestly
I’m pretty disappointed in the princess it’s definitely either under new management or they just got so busy they don’t have to try as hard because people will show up anyway kinda feeling I got
Our room was clean but the AC doesn’t really work that great because we set it to 72 but it struggles to make 76 and it’s only 93 outside watch out in the real heat that’s coming!
I’ve experienced that here multiple times before with the rooms having AC issues and it’s not something taken very seriously in my opinion
The grounds were clean
The slide pool had zero seating and was so packed we left and that’s usually a great relaxing spot for us
The beach pool was a mad house and the water was murky u couldn’t see the bottom it was nasty I wouldn’t get in but the kids barely wanted to either
The food was still good but I think this will be the last time we come back for sure especially now the wife has experienced the Gold room circus
For the money other resorts offer more with a better capacity to handle mass crowds and offer more amenities like lazy rivers and faster service from the staff who don’t seem as stretched thin
The Princess was always the high class less packed resort that tried harder it has always had events for the kids and u really felt like u were getting miles away but today it’s just feeling like another low budget circus reminding me of Costco and Walmart kind of madhouse I can get by going to any regular event in the valley
I’m still rating it 4 stars because it’s still clean on the grounds and the food was good but don’t expect the amenities or the pools to deliver a good experience and forget about the kids events either.
I’m definitely disappointed to see it get so run down like the madness of a theme park with no rides or really anything to do so take away the relaxation and u have a very weird vibe
Bring back the old Princess!

reviews.author: Eric Martin
reviews.text: Excellent resort hotel with a lovely pool and spa. Pricey, but a wonderful experience.

reviews.author: Sarah McCoy
reviews.text: We had a great stay! We loved staying in the Gold suites. The room was great as was the breakfast and afternoon snacks!  We enjoyed the pool and waterslides.  Hacienda and Toro were fantastic!  I can't wait to come back.

reviews.author: Randy Bell
reviews.text: Service was average.  Took too long waiting on phone to request service

reviews.author: Mark Mc
reviews.text:
Attended conference.
Did not stay overnight on site.

reviews.author: Ron Kendig
reviews.text: Phenomenal. The Mexican restaurant on site was fantastic. They have a great spicy margarita made with Serrano infused tequila.

reviews.author: Nicholas Pela
reviews.text: Great resort ! Book a Jeep tour through the concierge desk. Native & Cowboy guides will blow your mind

reviews.author: T
reviews.text: As a neighbor I sure wish the Fairmont would be more courteous to the people that live in the area. Feels like they got a new sound system recently because the music is louder than ever! It's a Thursday night at 9:20pm and we can't enjoy a quiet evening because the music is blaring. I'm more understanding during the holiday season but come on now be more respectful and mindful of your neighbors.

reviews.author: FAY E.
reviews.text: I live locally so I only use the Well Being Spa Services. Excellent in every aspect - friendly staff, professional practitioners, clean, great ambiance, including the pool area. Pool side drinks were light on alcohol and pricey though.

reviews.author: Emilee Pool
reviews.text: We came a few days ago from Banff Canada and the service was incredible. We came for the pools and where greeted by Alec who then introduced us to Thomas from guest services was exceptional giving us a tour of the property was defiantly a highlight. The pool bar staff where very nice and friendly too Nadia and Hailey gave us great recommendations in Flagstaff and Sedona. We got the opportunity to eat at Torro as well it was really beautiful being on the golf course as well as our server Joslynn W was incredible. We heard great things about the La Bomba before coming and it did not disappoint. Visiting the Scottsdale Princess was a dream and everyone we met made it incredibly memorable.

reviews.author: Rhonda Proctor
reviews.text: Our tired wing of rooms was disappointing. I'm sure the casitas on the course and centrally located rooms were great.

reviews.author: Adrian Ruiz
reviews.text: The place is very beautiful during the Christmas season. It has areas for skating, walking, and various activities throughout its large hotel. There are also places to eat. Parking is a bit expensive at $50 USD; I recommend parking nearby and walking, if permitted.

reviews.author: Rosalie Butler
reviews.text: Event staff were courteous, expeditious, and very knowledgeable. Hotel is beautiful and location is great!

reviews.author: Jackie Kapcheck
reviews.text: We had a brief company reward trip. The spa and gym were the pinnacle of the property for us as we work out daily. Enjoyed staying in Gold section and walking the distance to the gym. The spa pool was shangri-la! Many pools scattered throughout resort so kept the sunny days poolside always fresh. We did not golf, but course we heard from others was amazing and well kept. The staff was uber-polite and always greeted us when walking by. For those mobile-challenged, they offered free golf cart rides any time day or night. Hacienda was amazing. Lobby Bar super lively and fun. We only left the property once and felt like we had everything we needed onsite. My husband could even work from the room comfortably for several hours while I went to a class or extended walk. Then perfect balance for his rest of day - grabbing bites and a drink at the Gold Lounge. Worth the upgrade - honestly, could have eaten 2 meals a day which are included in Gold and that would have been enough for us.

reviews.author: Danail Stoyanov
reviews.text: Just lovely in every way.

reviews.author: Scott Noble
reviews.text: Just a beautiful property. Very relaxing. Food is unbelievable.

reviews.author: Zena Sowell
reviews.text: Samantha, at the concierge desk, was most helpful for my sister and I.  She assisted us with our departure check-in and printing boarding passes. We are most grateful as the business center FedEx location would not allow us to do so without extra charge using the FedEx computer. Kudos to Samantha. Keep up the beautiful smile and great job!

reviews.author: Katelyn Howell
reviews.text: Amazing service. Clean and comfortable rooms. Super yummy restaurants that gave big quantities of food. So many pools to choose from. Never felt busy! Never waited. Amazing!!

reviews.author: Patti Dunn
reviews.text: Have stayed here several times in the past.   Love the location, the amenities, the promise… but the delivery was spotty. Great service poolside at the spa.  Fabulous breakfast service experience Ironwood American Kitchen.  Less than flavorful dinner at La Hacienda.  And the overarching theme … at check-in, the Front Desk gentleman made a point of saying I booked an AAA booking (false… I booked on ScottsdalePrincess website using their offered AAA rate) when I asked for the best room in my rate class. He proceeded to offer me a villa like I had on my last stay for an additional charge of $750/night. When I declined and said just the best view/location of my current rate as it was my daughter’s first visit to the property, he smiled and said his pleasure.  When we were delivered to the room, to my disappointment, it was on the ground level against the rear service access road with the view being the apartment building or the like against the property.  We were put out to pasture.  The resort was clearly not at capacity or close to it.  Did I need an upgrade?  No. But I’m pretty sure there were other rooms with a bit better location to make our visit to YOUR property more memorable. And us more likely to return.  Checking out with a $4500 bill for 2 nights and 2 days  was pretty steep for the accommodations and overall experience.  We will likely try Boulders or JW MARRIOTT Camelback on my next return to Scottsdale (which I visit twice a year on business).

reviews.author: J D
reviews.text:
Pretty nice place spread across a vast area. I have been there a number of times. I was a little disappointed today to see that they allowed two dogs into the sand beach pool area only to be barking while people are trying to enjoy themselves and eat. Kind
of surprised they would allow animals in that area.

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.text: This resort is beautiful, friendly Staff and some of the greatest food we have had in a long time. full of great people that really go above and beyond.  We will 100% be back to the resort it was truly a relaxing,  high quality time with the family.  If you go to Bourbon Steak (you should) Cole is amazing!!

reviews.author: LuVerne Underhill
reviews.text: Excellent luncheon

If you like a spa day then you don’t have to leave the property to pamper yourself. Was here for a business event but will make it a priority to come back for pleasure.

reviews.author: Dena Thobe
reviews.text: Was here for a work conference. Staff was fantastic, the hotel was an amazing and views were wonderful!

The most luxurious resort in the Phoenix Scottsdale area. If you know you know. Two of the best restaurants also on premises, Bourbon Steak and La Hacienda.
(iykyk) 😎

reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed four nights.
We ate at two different restaurants on site. We were very pleased with the food and staff.
Phenomenal customer service.

reviews.author: Dana Elborno (thegirlgyno)
reviews.text: I had asked multiple times before arrival for a quiet room so kids can nap and we were placed right next to a loud pool. Our first impression was kind of weird. No one gave us a schedule of activities at hotel or a tour of property. There was no welcome drink. No one cleaned our room the first day. Many restos did not have a reservation and no one recommended to us on arrival to make reservations for meals. That being said, we loved the pools and the grounds. The food was inconsistent and healthy kid friendly options are limited. I can’t feed my kids chicken fingers and fries twice a day.  The grounds have something really special, but the reception leaves a bit to be desired.

reviews.author: Joseph Anthony De Mena
reviews.text:
My family and I reserved a Privado Casita and arrived to find that location is a separate lobby and entrance to the property. Immediately my wife and I were concerned to be too distant to the entire properties amenities. One of the welcome staff at the Privado lobby, Ryan, took us for a tour of the property i and immediately we knew the level of attention and hospitality was going meet or exceed our expectations. We were greeted even by Chana after our tour as our room was not ready yet and Chana could not have been nicer and Kind. She made us comfortable with their welcome drinks and snacks. She made my kids laugh and my wife and I feel at ease. The entire stay from that moment on was fantastic. The restaurants on property were delicious to include Toro by shuttle. Room service was fantastic and drinks to the room were as if just ordered from a bar.

Again, big shout out to Ryan and Chana for being responsive and hospitable during our entire stay. Also. Thank you to Sarah Vaughn who created our entire itinerary for
The trip to include golf, kids golf lessons and dinners.

Can't wait to come back!

reviews.author: Michael P
reviews.text: What an amazing resort.  Very pretty and well kept grounds.  Very clean.  While not new.  Lots is recently refurbished or lovingly maintained. But the Fairmont really shines in service.  Lots of friendly, helpful and effective staff.  You can just tell how well run they are and how customer service focused they are.  Great experience.

reviews.author: Travis Carter
reviews.text:
We stayed at the princess

For 4 days and three nights
We enjoyed ourselves immensely, and your staff was super helpful in every aspect

reviews.author: Brianna Taylor
reviews.text: We used resort pass to get access to the pool for the day and loved it! The food was great and the service was amazing

reviews.author: Justin Chau
reviews.text:
We stayed here for a family and friends vacation. The grounds are spectacular. These were easily some of the most beautiful rooms we've ever stayed in; the nightly cost is steep but the use of the funds are evident in how many people are working to keep up the facilities at any given time. We were so impressed by the attentiveness of the service from housekeeping to dining, the cleanliness of all facilities, and the amount of things available to occupy our children (nighttime outdoor movies, kids club, Sonoran Splash slides, etc.). The pools are well-stocked with surprise amenities like sunscreen and aloe lotion dispensers and constantly-filled iced water jugs throughout. La Hacienda had very delicious food, though spendy. It's a perk just to be able to walk around the resort. Photos do not do justice to the beauty of this place. We were in absolute awe. It is really like an oasis in the desert.
The only downside I could see - and I think it is something that should be said - is that this is not a smoke-free facility, and throughout the week we noticed several hotel guests smoking cigarettes outdoors and in gathering spaces such as the Plaza Bar, which I think also sells cigars. I was surprised to find this to be the case in 2026, and thus if you have respiratory conditions such as asthma you may want to reconsider this location until the policy is changed to potentially limit smoking to more remote locations so it isn't wafting across your room's balcony or past your dinner table. All in all, however, we did love our stay and will definitely return for a repeat visit.

reviews.author: Bob Newmyer
reviews.text: Multiple maintenance issues throughout our stay: broken shower head in room and at pool, broken latch to toilet; ice machine constantly beeping down the hall with no one responding to remedy the alert; carpet was steamed resulting in poor odor of the hallway with poor ventilation after carpet cleaning; wayfinding was complicated by many private events closing spaces at various times; water slides were slow and each of us got stuck on them a few times

reviews.author: Simon Ryder
reviews.text:
The service and general helpfulness by all staff was first class. I just thought maybe the property itself was in need of some TLC. Tired rooms, not 5* experience at the pool (an attendant host should welcome, lead to a lounger etc - especially at the smaller adults pool).
Housekeeping often didn’t happen until the evening or even well into the night, which is not good…and absolutely no sign of a turn down service (especially as sometimes a housekeeper was still serving my room at 9:30pm!).

reviews.author: Kelly Friedrich
reviews.text:
We had an absolutely amazing stay at the Fairmont Scottsdale Princess. Our Privado room for five felt incredibly luxurious and spacious, and the Privado lobby was so convenient—it made everything feel even more relaxed and elevated from the moment we arrived.

The attention to detail throughout the property was outstanding, and you can really tell the staff takes pride in creating a special experience for guests. The restaurants were fantastic—great food, great service, and very accommodating for families with kids.

The pools were clean, fun, and perfect for families, and despite how much the resort offers, the entire hotel still felt peaceful and well maintained. It struck a great balance between being lively and relaxing.

We truly loved our stay and made some amazing family memories here. We will absolutely be back!

reviews.author: Fia Hoffmann
reviews.text:
I rarely, if ever, write hotel reviews, but this place compels me to do so. It may be the most egregious example of a property claiming “luxury” while delivering the exact opposite.

The experience began with a driver (of the cart to my room) whose demeanor was indistinguishable from something out of a military transport. He made a point of informing me that Arizona is a carry-gun state and that he was armed. This was unsettling and entirely inappropriate.

Upon arrival, I was placed in a room located, felt like miles away from any central amenities, in 100-degree desert heat. You are effectively stranded, with no practical option but to remain confined to the room.

That confinement might have been tolerable had the rest not been so unacceptable. During a group dinner at La Hacienda, the hotel’s Mexican restaurant, I ordered the exorbitantly priced lobster tacos. They were smaller than the palm of my hand, and despite the minimal portion, I ended up with food poisoning. I spent the entire night vomiting. Unsurprisingly, the following day— half of my two-day stay — was lost to being bedridden.

The room itself was uninhabitable in any meaningful sense. The air conditioning unit cycles on every ten minutes at an intolerable volume. Turning it off to get any sleep results in the room rapidly becoming overheated, and since the windows are sealed, there is no possibility of fresh air.

Basic service was nonexistent. There was no room cleaning, no replenishment of towels or the coffee machine. Two small cartons of water were provided, wholly insufficient, especially given the desert heat and the dehydration from food poisoning.

Then, of course, the final insult: the bill. An added “resort fee,” plus tax, bringing the total to nearly $1,300 per night. Paying that amount to become ill from the only meal consumed, and to be effectively confined in what feels like a sealed plastic enclosure, is indefensible.

The so-called “princess experience” is a misnomer. I left drained, exhausted, and sick. This was not luxury, it was a failure on every conceivable level.

reviews.author: Danielle Smith
reviews.text: Amazing experience. I stayed in the Casitas and it was truly royal treatment. Several pools, restaurants, beach pool, stores with clothing and souvenirs. It's a huge resort.

reviews.author: Shannon P
reviews.text:
The rooms are exceptional.
The resort is well maintained.
The pools provide the best options for everyone.
The restaurants are to die for - Bourbon Steak, La Hacienda, Ironwood - all amazing.
For family fun, relaxation and gourmet dining - you simply cannot go wrong with Fairmont Scottsdale!

reviews.author: Lisa McCall
reviews.text: Gorgeous, sprawling property with a beautiful spa and great staff.

reviews.author: Lauren Oliver
reviews.text: My mom and I went to the Well & Being spa and were blown away. We are avid spa lovers and this is the BEST spa ever. The rooftop pool is such a vibe and the food is amazing. Get the lettuce wraps, trust me. The male pool servers were so attentive! I left my Stanley at the pool and Alex took the time to bring it all the way down for me. Alison at the front desk was so sweet and recommended yogurt dipping sauce with our fruit and we took it and it was so yummy! 100/10 recommend! Thank you!

reviews.author: Kevin Tran
reviews.text: Our ADA room which we waited an hour for upon arrival smells like toxic raw sewage, which extends at least 30 feet in every direction. I would have a more sanitary experience in a tent. Edit: we just found out that management lied to local emergency services saying that we did not reach out to the front desk first when requesting medical evaluation from issues resulting from occupying the room for less than one hour.

reviews.author: Barbara Hudock
reviews.text: Compared with the Lake Louise Fairfield, it wasn’t even in the same field.  NOT a 5 star hotel.

reviews.author: Bill Hladik
reviews.text: Very extensive property beautifully landscaped, right on TPC Scottsdale Stadium course. A-one caliber.

reviews.author: Lisa Blume
reviews.text: I’m a hard critic and I’ve truly had the most sun-kissed magical family spring break vacation. My daughter has truly enjoyed the kids club and made so many wonderful friends. The children pools are shallow so I’m not worried about drowning. The service  has been a 15/10. Our last vacation was at Baha Mar in Bahamas and it was so oversold, over overcrowded, the service was TERRIBLE, and we were nickel and dimed for everything. That experience made this one at the fairmont princess Scottsdale so noticeably luxury and amazing.

reviews.author: Kimberly Kenific [Breisacher]
reviews.text:
Our stay at the Fairmont Scottsdale Princess for my brother’s and my 50th birthday was truly exceptional. We traveled with our spouses and friends, and from the moment we arrived, everything felt thoughtful and elevated.

We stayed in Privado, and the suites were beautiful—spacious, comfortable, and designed to feel like a true home away from home. We were welcomed with birthday balloons from housekeeping and a slice of incredible cake from the hotel, which was such a special touch.

Throughout the entire stay, the service stood out. From breakfast to the pool, to the bars and every dinner, the staff was consistently warm, attentive, and genuinely focused on making the experience memorable.

We had lunch at Toro Latin Restaurant & Rum Bar with stunning golf course views, spent afternoons enjoying great poolside service, and had an incredible dinner at Bourbon Steak Scottsdale. The concierge also recommended a helicopter tour of the red rocks, which ended up being a true highlight of the trip.

We wrapped up our stay with a fantastic meal at La Hacienda at the Fairmont Scottsdale Princess and a relaxing evening by the outdoor fireplaces—such a perfect ending.

An amazing place for a milestone celebration. We’ll absolutely be back.

reviews.author: Mallory Shuck
reviews.text: This resort was great for kids.  With 5 pools to chose from we never got bored. We had great breakfasts and lunches.  The Villas were the perfect blend of togetherness and space. We truly enjoyed our stay at the Fairmont.  We would definitely come back.

reviews.author: Scott Biggs
reviews.text: It's tired!  Needs a major remodel update. Not like it used to be.

reviews.author: DB Horn
reviews.text: 5-star service in a stunning, spotlessly clean environment. Large property serves families and adults equally well. And, yes, it’s a dry heat. Comfortable in the shade even on a hot day. Kate and Merrisa were great servers during our stay

reviews.author: JP B
reviews.text: Nice expansive property. Multiple pool options is another strength. Pretty average from hospitality service standpoint. When our family returns to Scottsdale will head back to Phoenician/Canyon Suites for a better experience.

reviews.author: Brad Fastenau
reviews.text: The Fairmont princess Scottsdale was a wonderful resort spacious/full of plenty of desert vegetation. We enjoyed all of the service and amenities at the resort from the spa to all the pools and the shuttles back and forth to the various locations. Would definitely recommend for a family or a couples retreat. The service was impeccable. They were on the point with all the housekeeping room service spa service. You name it. The service was impeccable and well worth every penny.

reviews.author: anita aguilar
reviews.text:
UPDATE Staff email has NOT responded after calls and emails

I’m writing to share our experience because our recent stay at this resort was far from relaxing and nowhere near the standard we expected from a Fairmont property.

When we checked in, the bellman told us the only restaurant open was serving until 5pm. After a long day of travel, we rushed over—only to learn they had actually closed at 3pm. We ended up eating pool bar food just to get something in our system.

Once we finally got to our room, we tried to put our toddler down for a much-needed nap, but extremely loud music was blasting from outside. We called the front desk multiple times with no answer and even emailed the concierge because the noise was preventing our son from sleeping. At the same time, our AC wasn’t working, and repeated calls for help went unanswered. After several failed attempts to get our son to sleep, we had to give up and rush to dinner.

Dinner at La Hacienda was another disappointment. They do not make any modifications, and the meats are all heavily pre-seasoned—either extremely salty or spicy. The chef even refused to butterfly a filet. After sending back two meals, the only things we could actually eat were rice and chips. This is definitely not a family-friendly restaurant and not a place I’d recommend for anyone with dietary needs, kids, or simply wanting a relaxing meal.

On top of all this, the resort is hosting a massive holiday event. If you’re looking for peace or rest, this is not the place. The front desk assured us the music would end at 10pm, but it continued far beyond that night after night. It honestly felt like trying to sleep in the middle of a rave, times a hundred. They described it as “Disneyland in the desert,” and that’s exactly what it felt like. We had no idea what we were walking into.

Meanwhile, our AC issue continued for almost three days. It would randomly turn on and off, blowing hot or cold air on its own, and the constant temperature swings eventually got me sick. After more than 17 attempts, unanswered calls, and multiple “We’ll call you back” promises that never happened, it was finally confirmed that the AC didn’t work. Our parents’ AC was fixed sooner, but when they eventually moved us to another room, it ended up being in an even louder part of the resort.

Our spa visit was also disappointing. During my facial, the esthetician’s hands smelled strongly of garlic—even through her gloves. She mentioned she had been chopping garlic earlier, which was distracting and completely out of place for a luxury spa experience.

Between the noise, misinformation, lack of sleep, broken AC, unresponsive staff, disappointing dining, and the spa incident, this trip fell far below expectations. The repeated “How can we make it better?” lines felt scripted because nothing actually improved.

There were several more issues, but the bottom line is simple:

If you’re looking for relaxation, this is not the resort for you—especially during the holiday event season. Visit for the lights at night if you’re curious, but stay elsewhere if you value rest, quiet, reliability, or even basic follow-through.

Looking back, the disorganization, lack of communication, and constant misinformation should’ve been my first red flag that this resort just didn’t have its systems—or its guest experience—together.
